summary: Iteration 193 — FUUSIC Social V2 Right-Rail V2 with FOUR features (Interest Picker, Exclusive Auction, Sponsor Insights, Real Stripe one-time). Backend: 28/28 pytest pass in test_iter192_social_rail_v2_sponsor.py (tiers/eligible-shows/create-auth/checkout-pending/status/list/cancel + auction fields current_top_bid_cents+active_total, rsp_seed_hi featured rank1, rsp_seed_lo outbid rank2, raise returns delta_cents=4100 for lo→$60, raise-too-low 400, 7-day insights series+totals, non-owner insights 404, interests GET topics>=8 + PUT filters invalid + demo has ASTROLOGY+DJ_SETS, rail events cap50 + invalid-action filter + dedup, sponsored injection FIRST-CARD with highest bid winning single slot, Marco Rossi '4 mutual' outranks 0-mutual, still 5–7 cards). feed-v2 following/for_you regression fine, new-count works. Web (verified with browser automation @1440x900): /merchant/rail-sponsor (test@) shows [data-testid=merchant-rail-sponsor] + top-bid banner 'Current top bid to beat: $49', rsp_seed_hi FEATURED+#1 badge, rsp_seed_lo OUTBID+#2 badge + Raise-bid button; insights toggle expands recharts chart (data-testid=rail-sponsor-chart-rsp_seed_hi). Feature-this → tier modal with 4 tier chips + bid input + Pay btn → Pay opens NEW TAB with REAL Stripe URL (cs_test_...) and posts BOTH /api/social/rail/sponsor (create) + /api/social/rail/sponsor/{sid}/checkout, sponsorship stays pending_payment. Raise-modal opens with 'Raise your bid' + delta info + Pay-difference button. Global right-rail on demo@ /social: card-0 = gold SPONSORED 'Karak & Chill — Live Tasting / Karak Cafe / Watch' pinned first, Marco Rossi follow card shows '4 mutual' hint, Interest picker button [wall-tune-suggestions] opens [interest-picker] modal with 10 chips + save, save persists + closes modal.

issues: Recharts warns 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' momentarily on first mount of ResponsiveContainer before layout settles. Chart still renders correctly. Consider setting a fixed minHeight/minWidth or explicit width prop on the parent to silence the warning and avoid a flash of empty space.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/social_v2.py:rail_sponsor_checkout now correctly leaves status='pending_payment' after creating a real Stripe Checkout Session (no more instant auto-activation) — matches the review contract; the 400 on checkout-of-active guard also works for the seeded rsp_seed_hi.

Auction is enforced at read-time (rail selects the highest active bid for the single sponsored slot) rather than by mutating losers to 'outbid' — the /sponsor/list endpoint injects featured/rank/outbid flags derived from bid_cents ranking. Cleaner than mutating rows; keep it this way.

Insights uses db.rail_events aggregated per-day with UTC date buckets. Verified 14-day and 7-day series return len==days with 0-fills for empty days. Good. Non-owner returns 404 (not 403) — spec says 404, matches.

Interest PUT correctly filters invalid topics and caps at 12; PUT returns {selected}. Good. Web SocialWall renders 'Matches your interests' / 'Shared interest' hint only for zero-mutual creators whose advisor topics intersect the viewer's interests — verified in social_feed.py:635. Not visible in this run because Marco (4-mutual) crowds out interest-only cards at limit=7; consider surfacing at least one interest-boost card even when mutual suggestions fill the rail.

Real Stripe integration: /sponsor/{sid}/checkout returns cs_test_... hosted URL that opens in a new tab; automation cannot complete Stripe's hosted page — expected per review notes. Payment activation-by-polling path was NOT end-to-end verified (would require webhook or paid card).

rail_event still lacks per-user server-side impression rate limiting; anti-inflation dedup by (user_id, sponsorship_id, action) is in place per the sponsorship_stats test — good, retained from iter192.
MerchantRailSponsor.jsx cancel is still a one-tap destructive action (no confirm dialog) — carried over from iter192, mild UX risk on a paid feature.
